voice: Warm, direct, quick Punjabi; unsentimental; lowers her voice rather than raises it

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Oval face, wide-set intelligent eyes, soft jaw, straight nose, a tiny scar on the chin; laugh lines

skin.description: Medium wheatish; flushed cheeks from the kitchen heat; faint flour dust on forearms in Act 1-2
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

groom.hair: Long braid, black with a few silver strands

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Light cotton salwar kameez in muted colours; thin dupatta
outfits.monsoon: Cotton salwar kameez; dupatta pinned; plastic slippers
outfits.winter: Salwar kameez with a hand-knitted cardigan and a shawl
outfits.by_act: A1=printed everyday salwar kameez with an apron over it at work; A2=the same suits, mended and worn; A5=the last day: a plain suit she would wear to the gurdwara

accessories: Thin gold earrings; steel or gold kada; bangles; steel tiffin carriers and a cloth bundle; no heavy makeup
tells: Taps the rim of a steel tiffin lid when she is angry and not saying it
gait_notes: Quick, practical walk carrying weight on the hip or head; stops to check the boy; stands with arms folded when worried
sensitivity: A working mother and small-business owner, shown with competence. Her death in Act 5 is never used as spectacle.
